title: ToLowerCamel returns an uppercase first letter when input starts with a separator
property: the result of ToLowerCamel never starts with an uppercase letter
evidence: ToLowerCamel is documented as converting to lowerCamelCase; the existing test shows a leading space is ignored (" some string" -> "someString"), but a leading '_', '-' or '.' sets capNext at i==0 and capitalizes the first letter.
